summary: Ledger→Money consolidation verified end-to-end. FRONTEND (Expo web, 390x844): bottom tab bar shows exactly 5 tabs — Money, Mileage, Reports, Ask, Profile — with testIDs tab-home/tab-trips/tab-reports/tab-ask/tab-settings. The old Ledger tab (tab-expenses) is REMOVED (querySelector returns null). All 5 tabs navigate cleanly with no red-screen and no pageerrors. Money tab (/home) period toggle works: tapping money-period-today shows 'NET EARNINGS · TODAY', money-period-fy shows 'NET EARNINGS · FY 26–27' (AU Jul–Jun, country-aware from profile), money-period-all shows 'NET EARNINGS · ALL-TIME'; Net/Income/Expenses figures recompute per period. Quick-add flows: ledger-add-income opens /entry?type=income; expense-add opens /entry?type=expense; saving via entry-save returns to /home and updates Net (verified $100 income + $40 expense → Net $60, Income $100, Expenses $40, category tile 'Fuel $40.00'). ledger-history-toggle expands History; testIDs ledger-<uuid> and ledger-del-<uuid> render for each row; the count line reads '2 entries · today' and toggling to FY updates to '2 entries · fy 26–27' (filtering is per-period). Tapping a row navigates to /entry?type=expense&id=<uuid> with entry-amount prefilled ('40'). Deletion via ledger-del-<uuid> removes the row from the DOM. BACKEND: full pytest suite 68/68 pass on retry (test_ask_assistant.py::test_ask_au_out_of_scope_refuses is intermittently flaky — the LLM correctly refuses the France/Netflix question but occasionally uses phrasing outside the strict refuse_markers list; not related to this consolidation; passes on rerun). Direct curl against the external base URL: GET /api/dashboard, GET /api/tax-mileage, GET /api/reports?period=quarter, GET /api/vehicles (profile_id=smoketest) all return 200; POST /api/ask {question, country:'AU'} returns 200. No MongoDB _id leak observed.

minor.issue: Pre-existing stochastic flakiness in test_ask_assistant.py::test_ask_au_out_of_scope_refuses — Claude sometimes refuses with 'isn\'t something I can help with — I\'m only set up to answer Australian gig-economy tax questions' instead of the strict 'verified sources / registered tax professional' phrases in refuse_markers. The refusal behavior is correct; only the assertion is too strict. Suggest broadening markers to include 'only set up to answer' / 'can\'t help with'.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing non-blocking console warning carried from prior iterations: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not introduced by this consolidation.

action_items: None blocking — feature ready to ship. Optional: broaden refuse_markers in test_ask_assistant.py::test_ask_au_out_of_scope_refuses to include 'only set up to answer', 'can\'t help with', 'isn\'t something I can help with' to eliminate stochastic LLM flakiness (behavior is correct).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx now declares exactly 5 Tabs.Screen entries (home/trips/reports/ask/settings) with corresponding tabBarButtonTestIDs. Ledger removed cleanly (expenses.tsx deleted per handoff note).

frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx cleanly implements the merged Money screen: PERIODS array drives testIDs money-period-{today,fy,all}; range is derived via useMemo (today from toLocaleDateString('en-CA'); AU FY = Jul–Jun, US FY = Jan–Dec); summary + rows are useMemo'd off inRange filter — recomputes instantly on period change. Category breakdown and business-km card both honour the selected range. History rows use stable key `${row.kind}-${row.id}` and testID `ledger-${row.id}` / `ledger-del-${row.id}`.
Client-side FY filter is country-aware from the profile store (default AU). Verified 'FY 26–26' label rendered as 'FY 26–27' for August 2026, matching AU FY26–27 (1 Jul 2026 – 30 Jun 2027).
No MongoDB _id leak on any tested endpoint (spot-checked /api/vehicles and /api/dashboard responses).
home.tsx is 365 lines — under the 700-line file-size guideline.

success_rate.backend: 100% (68/68 pytest — retry-stable; 1 LLM-stochastic test passes on rerun)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (5-tab layout, period toggle, quick-add, history expand, row-tap prefill, delete — all verified)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral profile_id='smoketest' used for e2e; created 1 income ($100) and 1 expense ($40) during history/delete flow, both cleaned up at end of run (dashboard shows income_today=0, expense_today=0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 5 tabs = tab-home (Money), tab-trips (Mileage), tab-reports (Reports), tab-ask (Ask), tab-settings (Profile). No tab-expenses. Money tab testIDs: money-period-{today,fy,all}, ledger-add-income, expense-add, expense-scan, ledger-history-toggle, ledger-<uuid>, ledger-del-<uuid>. Entry screen testIDs: entry-amount, entry-save, entry-close, entry-merchant (expense only), entry-platform-*, entry-treatment-*, entry-date, entry-note. FY is country-aware: AU Jul–Jun (default), US Jan–Dec. To bootstrap /home: set localStorage 'gigtax.profile_id'=JSON.stringify('<pid>') and PUT /api/profile?profile_id=<pid> with {onboarded:true, country:'AU'}. Cleanup test data via DELETE /api/income/<id>?profile_id=<pid> and DELETE /api/expenses/<id>?profile_id=<pid>.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects reproduced in the consolidation. The one intermittent pytest failure is a pre-existing over-strict assertion on LLM refusal phrasing and is unrelated to the Money-tab merge.
